pages.text: Create adds machines you build and power yourself - nothing runs on its own.$(br2)Craft a $(bold)Water Wheel$() and place it next to flowing water to make your first source of rotational power.
The bigger the wheel and the more water touching it, the more power (called $(bold)Stress$() and $(bold)SU$()) it makes. That power needs to travel somewhere - see the next page!
